purpose: Define one evidence-honest measurement contract for data, model, architecture, experiment, result, evaluation, and test quality across the VEGO-AI research program.

scoringRule.method: Report each dimension separately as pass, partial, fail, not measured, not applicable, or not eligible. A dimension proportion is allowed only when its numerator and denominator are explicit.
scoringRule.notApplicableTreatment: Not-applicable and not-eligible dimensions are never converted to zero and never included in a blended score.

baselineLadder.title: Frozen original Agent 4
baselineLadder.purpose: Preserve the official original classification output and paper-aligned architecture reference.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Available for integrity, mechanism, and later paired expert comparisons.

baselineLadder.title: Non-destructive H-layer mechanism
baselineLadder.purpose: Measure M1–M4B-1 review, feedback, memory, advice, comparison, unified-contract, and parity behavior.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Available for mechanism, architecture, routing, safety, and reproducibility evaluation.

baselineLadder.title: Independent expert-labeled baseline
baselineLadder.purpose: Establish classification validity and reviewer agreement against generalization-safe gold labels.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Requires two independent reviewers, adjudication, and at least 20 safe labels for limited MSc quantitative reporting.

baselineLadder.title: Frozen deterministic candidate
baselineLadder.purpose: Compare one preregistered non-destructive policy candidate on development data.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Requires B2, completed error analysis, accepted M-decisions, and a frozen policy version.

baselineLadder.title: Sealed holdout pilot
baselineLadder.purpose: Measure a frozen candidate once on the sealed eight-row holdout.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Requires B3 and an unopened partition hash; the result remains a pilot.

baselineLadder.title: External education replication
baselineLadder.purpose: Test external validity on a new education-domain batch.
baselineLadder.eligibility: Requires B4, supervisor approval, and an independently labeled external cohort.

dimensions.title: Protocol quality
dimensions.question: Is the experiment question, baseline, comparator, metric set, gate, threat model, and claim boundary specified before interpretation?
criteria: Research question is explicit.
Baseline and comparator are explicit.
Primary metrics are named.
Approval and dependency gates are visible.
Validity threats and claim boundary are explicit.
At least one auditable artifact is linked.
dimensions.passRule: All six required protocol elements are present.

dimensions.title: Data quality
dimensions.question: Are source identity, cohort, denominator, missingness, provenance, leakage, and eligibility represented correctly?
criteria: Every measured observation has a source hash.
Every measured observation has a cohort hash.
Every measured observation has a denominator.
Missing values remain explicit.
Synthetic and same-pattern evidence cannot become generalization-safe.
Controlled records remain outside tracked artifacts.
dimensions.passRule: All applicable measured observations satisfy provenance, denominator, missingness, and leakage constraints.

dimensions.title: Execution validity
dimensions.question: Did the accepted run complete, validate, and meet its declared execution criteria?
criteria: At least one accepted run exists for an executed experiment.
Run execution status is completed.
Run evaluation marks execution valid.
Acceptance criteria are recorded.
dimensions.passRule: Every accepted run for the experiment satisfies every execution requirement.

dimensions.title: Reproducibility
dimensions.question: Can the experiment be replayed from immutable, hash-bound inputs with stable outputs?
criteria: Run manifest and source revision are recorded.
Input or cohort identity is hash-bound.
Metric definitions are versioned.
Determinism is measured where the protocol requires it.
Repeated-run differences remain visible.
dimensions.passRule: Provenance is complete and every required deterministic replay passes.

dimensions.title: Safety and authority
dimensions.question: Does the experiment preserve Agent 4, baseline outputs, human authority, and trusted-memory rules?
criteria: Baseline changes remain zero.
Timeout, denial, conflict, and missing evidence preserve baseline behavior.
Unsafe trusted-memory writes remain zero.
Automatic correction applications remain zero.
E15 cannot trigger an operational framework action.
dimensions.passRule: Every applicable safety measure is exact-pass; no partial safety pass is accepted.

dimensions.title: Comparison validity
dimensions.question: Are compared runs equivalent except for the declared treatment?
criteria: Dataset and partition hashes match.
Baseline, policy, prompt, and model versions match.
Metric definition and unit of analysis match.
Label eligibility, leakage class, cohort, and evidence class match.
Incomparable pairs are refused rather than plotted.
dimensions.passRule: All invariant fields match and only the declared treatment differs.

dimensions.title: Empirical classification validity
dimensions.question: Does the experiment contain sufficient independent, leakage-safe evidence for classification conclusions?
criteria: Two independent reviews and adjudication are complete.
At least 20 generalization-safe labels exist for limited MSc reporting.
Accuracy, macro-F1, class metrics, and paired outcomes use the frozen cohort.
Formal improvement uses unseen data and preregistered tests.
Subgroup harm and null results remain visible.
dimensions.passRule: The evidence tier and sample-size gate determine eligibility; positive improvement additionally requires the preregistered paired rules.

evidenceGates.effect: Accuracy, macro-F1, paired correctness, net correction, confidence intervals, and significance fields must be null.

evidenceGates.condition: generalization-safe label count is between 1 and 19
evidenceGates.effect: Only pilot descriptive reporting is allowed.

evidenceGates.condition: at least 20 adjudicated generalization-safe labels exist
evidenceGates.effect: Limited MSc quantitative reporting becomes eligible but is not automatically positive.

evidenceGates.condition: policy, prompt, partition, model, and metric versions are frozen before holdout inspection
evidenceGates.effect: A one-time sealed holdout pilot may be evaluated.

evidenceGates.condition: an independently labeled external education cohort exists
consent, task protocol, participant roles, and anonymized record handling are approved
evidenceGates.effect: BigUI usability, decision-support, or human-effort studies may execute.

statisticalRules: Macro-F1 is the primary classification metric; accuracy and balanced accuracy are secondary.
Net correction is the primary paired effect; changed-and-correct and changed-and-wrong remain separately visible.
Report Wilson intervals for proportions and paired-bootstrap intervals for macro-F1 and net-correction deltas.
Use exact McNemar only on a frozen paired unseen cohort.
A positive formal result requires a net-correction confidence interval excluding zero, exact McNemar p below 0.05, no macro-F1 decline, and no predefined subgroup harm.
Negative, mixed, null, and engineering-target-miss results remain reportable and cannot trigger post-hoc relabeling or silent retuning.

guardrails: safe N must be at least 20
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: B2 for limited MSc reporting; B4/B5 for held-out or external claims.

trackParameters.unitOfAnalysis: reconstructable lifecycle event and promoted review item
guardrails: high-severity coverage equals 1.0 for a recommended pilot
coverage at least 0.8 with load at most 0.5
churn capture at least 0.8 with at most 30 items per setting
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: Offline replay supports a Pareto boundary; adjudicated targets are required for precision and recall.

trackParameters.unitOfAnalysis: canonical H-layer artifact row and deterministic repetition
guardrails: classification and baseline changes equal zero
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: Equivalent immutable inputs across legacy, unified, and parity modes.

guardrails: no topology selected while M-02 is deferred
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: Offline structural simulator; live coordination claims are not allowed.
Deterministic negative fixtures; universal safety probability is not claimed.

trackParameters.unitOfAnalysis: mode, fixture scale, and deterministic repetition
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: Environment and cohort hashes; machine-specific results remain descriptive.

guardrails: formative median task success at least 0.8
confirmatory correctness improves without higher overclaim rate
trackParameters.minimumEvidence: Five to eight participants for formative findings; at least 20 counterbalanced participants for decision-support comparison.

claimBoundary: This standard evaluates research and engineering quality without guaranteeing classification accuracy. Empirical improvement remains not computable while the independent generalization-safe label count is zero.
